# `Q-3-54` — NoteDefinitionPara Not Supported in ANSI Format

> Note definitions cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

## What this means

A note definition is the body of a footnote whose reference
appears elsewhere in the document. The ANSI writer (used when
rendering to a terminal) does not yet render footnotes: a
terminal has no notion of a footnoted page, and the writer does
not currently coalesce the body into the reference site either.

## Why this happens

Your document uses note-definition syntax (`[^id]: body`) and
you rendered to ANSI output.

## How to fix

Two options:

- **Render to a different format.** HTML, PDF, and the markdown
  writers all handle footnotes.
- **Rewrite the footnote inline.** Change `text[^id]` plus
  `[^id]: body` into `text^[body]`, which puts the note body
  directly at the reference site.

## Related

- `Q-3-55` — fenced note definitions, same limitation for the
  multi-paragraph form.
- `Q-3-10` — the same limitation for the qmd writer, which has
  a different remediation story.
